profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp., known in Japanese as ソフトバンクグループ株式会社, is a Tokyo-based public company founded in 1981. Its website presents the company's philosophy, vision and strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations material, business segments and group companies, and sustainability (ESG) information. Masayoshi Son is named on the site as Representative Director, Chairman and CEO. The company's SEC central index key is 0001065521 and its ticker is SFTBF.

On AI, the site says it introduces the company's thinking for the era of the AI revolution, the efforts of group companies, and the possibilities that AI brings. That is the extent of the AI-specific material the site provides here; no individual AI products are named.

The site does not describe any litigation, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
